**Same-key repeats within 5 minutes now drop.** See [src/router.js:29](src/router.js:29).

State holds `lastSentAt`, a `Map` of key to last send time. Only real sends record, so a dropped repeat does not extend the window.

`node simulate.js` ran clean. 99 dropped, 0 errors.

I read "last 5 minutes" as a gap of 5 or less. Tell me if you want strictly under 5.
